ruleRefs.description: An application can only be recorded against a job position whose status is open.
A candidate can have at most one application to the same job position.
An application can only be rejected when a rejection reason is recorded, together with the stage it was in when rejected.
Only the hiring manager of the application's job position can extend an offer or hire the candidate; all other pipeline actions are performed by the recruiter.
A candidate can only be hired while the job position is open and its headcount is not yet filled.
A job position closes automatically, in the same operation as the hire, as soon as its number of hired applications reaches its headcount.
An application that is hired or rejected cannot move to any other stage.
A candidate must be registered with an e-mail address, along with a name, resume link and source.
Before a new candidate is registered, an existing candidate with the same e-mail address or national document is reused instead of creating a duplicate.
